title: Your secrets aren’t safe with this cute robot toy — they’re on Chinese servers ready to be hacked
description:
Eiliko. | Photo by Sean Hollister / The Verge	

There's a new digital pet in town - a cute little marshmallow of a robot that can change its cartoony expressions to match your mood. But if you or your kids talk to "Eiliko" over Wi-Fi, it'll phone home to China. Its AI companion can store literally everything you tell it on Chinese servers, where hackers can easily gain access or even hijack its personality. And the company that made it, Energize Lab, doesn't seem to care.
I bought an Eiliko from Amazon on August 29th. During a 10-minute conversation on August 30th, I asked the little bot: "Do you ever tell anybody else what I'm saying?"
"Your secrets are safe with me," it replied.
With …

descriptionDE: Ein Bundesrichter entschied, dass Apple auf die Interviewmaterialien von OpenAI mit ehemaligen Apple-Mitarbeitern sowie auf private Nachrichten und Aussagen von Schlüsselfiguren des Falles zugreifen kann.
titleDE: Richter befiehlt OpenAI, Einstellungsunterlagen im Fall von Apple-Geschäftsgeheimnissen herauszugeben

title: Flox Intelligence is building AI to keep wildlife away from trains, airports, and roads
description: Flox's edge devices can identify animals and use species-specific sounds to drive them away from critical infrastructure.
descriptionDE: Die Edge-Geräte von Flox können Tiere identifizieren und artspezifische Geräusche verwenden, um sie von kritischen Infrastrukturen fernzuhalten.

Das profitable Startup nimmt am Startup Battlefield bei TechCrunch Disrupt vom 13. bis 15. Oktober in San Francisco teil.
